# The behaviour spec

**Generated by `rebuild/tools/extract_behaviour.py` - do not edit by hand.**

Every assertion in the suites that cover the SHIPPED window and the domain.
gui2-driver says of itself that every one of its assertions was written
against a real defect and none are decorative - which makes these sentences
the only complete statement of what this tool is supposed to do.

**The 30,000 lines of PowerShell harness will not survive the rebuild.**
These sentences have to. Work through them as a checklist; each one is a
test to write in the new language, and the line reference is where to read
what it actually checked.
